pages.text: Waves follow armor, Protection, Projectile Protection and Resistance. Launch snapshots preserve Sharpness/Smite/Bane, Looting, Fire Aspect, Knockback and reinforcement. Switching weapons cannot alter an existing wave.

Fire Aspect burns for4 seconds/level; Knockback pushes along flight direction. Waves do not run Sweeping Edge or melee Thorns callbacks. Creative/spectator players, armor stands, fake players and owned pets are protected. Team friendly-fire rules remain authoritative.$(br2)combat.friendlyFire / combat.breakFragileBlocks
